description: Desktop E2E only (debug builds register the plugin; see lib.rs). Split out of `default` and limited to macOS + Linux because tauri-plugin-wdio-webdriver (<=1.4.0) pins webview2-com 0.38 / windows 0.61 and does not compile against Tauri 2.12's webview2-com 0.39 on Windows (v1.7.0 desktop release failure). tauri-build skips validating a capability whose `platforms` excludes the target, so the Windows build no longer needs the plugin's permission to exist. V2-3.2: windows are `home` + `p-*` (contract V2-1.1 §5.4; `c-*` cell tabs are in no capability), plus the debug-only window helpers in windows.rs (`window_labels`, `e2e_focus_window`, `e2e_close_window`) — their bodies are compiled only under `debug_assertions` and a release build answers Err, but they are still granted ONLY here, never in default.json.
